guitar.guitaristsText: Steve Hackett / Mike Rutherford / Daryl Stuermer
guitar.evidence: Steve Hackett (early era) was known for Gibson Les Pauls; Mike Rutherford and touring guitarist Daryl Stuermer covered guitar in the Phil Collins era. No single guitar is iconic for the band's commercial 80s hits listed here.

tone.target: bright mid-gain pop-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright mid-gain pop-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using a light OD boost into an AC30-style amp, enhanced by Chorus for pop sheen and Room reverb for subtle depth.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide light, tight crunch and boost the upper mids.
Add the required 'chorus sheen' without sounding washy.
Bypass (or use a very subtle boost if needed).
blocks.gap: The Green OD handles the required crunch; no dedicated distortion is necessary.
